title: Binance Will List Binance Staked SOL (BNSOL) and Introduce BNSOL Boosted APR Promotion
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  BNSOL  and open trading for  BNSOL/SOL  at  2024-10-10 08:00 (UTC) . How to Get BNSOL: There are 3 ways to get BNSOL: Navigate to [Earn] > [ SOL Staking ] and click [Stake SOL].  Stake SOL to BNSOL on  Binance Web3 Wallet . Deposit BNSOL  to your Binance account. Start Trading on Binance Spot Now! Promotion: Stake SOL to Receive BNSOL & Enjoy Boosted APR up to 10% During the Promotion Period, all  new and existing  BNSOL holders  will get  up to 10%*  in APR.   Promotion Period:  Approximately 8 - 10 days from 2024-10-16 (UTC).  *Note: The APR is likely to be between 8 - 10% during the Promotion Period, with fluctuations depending on the Total Value Locked per 2 - 3 days (each epoch). After the Promotion Period, the APR will revert back to the normal rate. For the latest APR, please refer to the  Binance SOL Staking page . About BNSOL: Binance Staked SOL (BNSOL) represents your staked SOL plus the staking rewards received, in a tradable and transferable form. Ordinary staking would lock up your staked assets, which means you cannot use them for other purposes – it increases a user's opportunity cost. In contrast, BNSOL provides flexibility to sell, transfer, or use the staked SOL position. You can even move BNSOL to a personal wallet, such as  Binance Web3 Wallet  and use it outside the Binance platform whilst still earning rewards. BNSOL accumulates staking rewards through the BNSOL:SOL conversion rate, even when it is used in other Binance products or external DeFi applications for additional yield opportunities. Users need to complete account verification to participate in the trading of this new trading pair. Please note that this list may be updated periodically to accommodate changes in legal, regulatory, or other factors. Currently, users residing in the following countries or regions will not be able to trade the aforementioned spot trading pairs: Australia, Canada, Cuba, Crimea Region, Iran, Japan, Kazakhstan, New Zealand, North Korea, Russia, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, Puerto Rico, the Northern Mariana Islands, the U.S. Virgin Islands), and any non-government controlled areas of Ukraine. Boosted APR Rewards are contributions made by Binance with the express purpose of facilitating promotional activities. The BNSOL:SOL conversion ratio is  dynamic  and will be  updated per Epoch  on the Solana network (approximately every 2 - 3 days). The Boosted APR will start from  Epoch 685 at approximately 2024-10-16 00:40 (UTC).  Users who stake SOL to receive BNSOL during the current Epoch will start enjoying the boosted APR only after the next Epoch refreshes. Please refer to  Binance SOL Staking Terms and Conditions  and  Risk Warning  prior to using SOL Staking. Binance reserves the right to cancel or amend the Promotion or Promotion Rules at its sole discretion. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.  Thank you for your support!
